admitted: New own-file ObjectSharedChunkStructureReadSpan holds the parsed record and parser-observed start/end offsets in the original prefix buffer.
Legacy and span APIs share a generic result parser; the legacy path creates no span wrappers.
The result array retains its original record-count capacity and post-roster/budget-preflight allocation point.
The separate suffix is charged once against the inherited read-direction budget; the prepaid prefix is not charged again.
Independent literal suffix pairs and one- and multibyte VarUInt headers distinguish byte boundaries from row counts or fabricated per-chunk callbacks.
